notes.title: Help BEAST succeed, now 40% off!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Beasts,[/h2]

This is Piotr Pacynko, founder of False Prophet Studio.
I personally wanted to thank you for showing interest in our game.
We've worked very hard to get to this point in our Early Access.

We would like to finalize the game by fixing bugs and polishing it to 1.0 as well as release it for consoles. For us Early Access is just that, a kickstarter where you have to prove yourself. We think that with such a great community, nice media coverage and steam reviews, we're off to a good start.

But marketing, PR and current sales alone is unfortunately not enough so we now turn to you dear community to help us spread the message of being able to buy "BEAST: False Prophet" for an incredible price during Steam sales. We have so many great ideas and plans for this game including additional DLC expansions beyond the 30-40 hours of missions currently available.

[b]Any kind of support will be so greatly appreciated and every single one of you reading this matters for the cause:[/b]
[list]
[*] Leaving a review on Steam
[*] Gifting the game to a friend, family member or loved one
[*] Telling your family, friends and loved ones about the sale
[*] Telling your favorite streamers about BEAST and ask them to stream it
[/list]
[b]If you're still keeping BEAST on the wishlist, now is the time to buy it for an incredible value and help us in the process to be able to complete our first game.[/b]

Thank you again for your consideration and support in making our dream a reality and Happy Holidays.

[i]~ Piotr & Team BEAST[/i]

notes.title: Major Update #2
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Travellers[/h1]

We hope this update will find you well, surrounded by joy & warmth, and ready for a new year.

Allow us to present our final update for this year and final game name, [b]BEAST: False Prophet[/b].

[previewyoutube=kCSJncwPaS0;full][/previewyoutube]

In the spirit of giving, we are excited to introduce you to our Major Update #2! Besides all new missions, enemies, and enhanced visuals, you can now finally play the game from start to finish and see our first ending! 

We've left no stone unturned in our quest to make BEAST an unforgettable adventure. We now hope current and future players will see the kind of game we want to finish developing.

As we stand on the edge of finalizing our game, we recognize that our journey has one more chapter of polishing and bugfixing to be done. 

We now turn to our amazing community for help in spreading the word and ask your friends to support future development by buying this early-access version.

Your continued support is the key to making BEAST the masterpiece it deserves to be. Together, let's bring this chapter to a close and set the stage for even more thrilling adventures ahead.

[b]At the end thank you for your amazing support and wish you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year! 🎄
[/b]

[b]➼ join our amazing community on Discord and connect with other players and the BEAST Dev Team![/b]

notes.title: Early Access - Major Update #1
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone,[/h1] 

[previewyoutube=9YzBJdmHDg4;full][/previewyoutube]

We've been hard at work readying up things for today.
This is [b]our biggest update so far[/b] and it brings a wealth of changes to improve your time in BEAST and give you lots of new content and variety now with more supported languages! It has been very important to us that we take our time with aspects that may alter the core gameplay. We have added [b]new missions, enemies, weapons, companions, camps[/b], and so much more.

[b]We've also worked on a ton of fixes and improvements largely based on your fantastic feedback [/b]received on Discord and forums. If you haven't played in a while, please pick it up again and try things and let us know what you think. As always with indie titles, [b]we're eternally grateful for your support in caring and sharing BEAST to your friends[/b]. If you haven't given us a review yet, we would love for you to do so as we read all of them! Lastly if you believe in our work, [b]feel free to nominate us for the Steam Awards and help spread the word about the game[/b]. It would mean so much!

[b] 👉 Don't forget to Join & Talk to us on [url=https://discord.gg/beastvideogame] Discord [/url][/b] 

Thank you again dear community!

[i][b]~ False Prophet Team[/b][/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35672639/146eaadbfdd7998d91b68eb0a20c4bc45609efba.png[/img]
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added UI and subtitle support (beta) for French, Italian, German, Spanish, Polish, Japanese and Simplified Chinese
[*] Added 17 new missions on 13 new maps
[*] Added 10 new enemy types and 5 new enemy classes
[*] Added 19 new weapons
[*] Added 9 new companions
[*] Added 11 new cutscenes
[*] Added 17 new camps
[*] Added NVIDIA DLSS support 
[*] Added Nudity mode toggle to settings

[h3]Community Patch #1,2,3 and 4 are included in this major update as well as additional fixes:[/h3]

[*] Added difficulty options when starting a new campaign
-  3 difficulty options: Easy, Normal, Hard
[*] Added an Ironman mode option when starting a new campaign
- In Ironman mode you only have one autosave slot
[*] Added a Hardcore mode option when starting a new campaign
- In Hardcore mode, allied characters don't go into a downed state when their Health reaches 0 but die instantly
[*] Added Overwatch ability for Igor the Coachman
[*] Added Tutorial skipping option

[/list]

[b]We're excited to announce the upcoming release of our Community Patch #2, packed with a host of improvements, bug fixes, and new content based on your valuable feedback. This patch is a collaborative effort between the development team and the dedicated BEAST community, and we're thrilled to share the details with you.[/b]

[b][u]Community-Requested Features[/u]: We've listened to your suggestions and we are implementing several features requested by the community! Do you have any idea how we could upgrade your gaming experience? Feel free to post your thoughts on Steam Forum or join our amazing community on [url=discord.gg/beastvideogame]Discord[/url] and connect with other players and BEAST Dev Team![/b]

[b][u]Skip tutorial[/u]: We understand that most of players will catch up quite fast what button does what and even if, after you played the tutorial once - who would want to play the tutorial maps each time you make a play-through, am I right?[/b]

[b]Now you don't have if you don't want to! Ready to dive into the deep waters from the start? We got you covered![/b]

[b]Here is a little GIF with explanation on how to skip the tutorial and start the game from the creation of your main character! Simply in the difficulty settings mark that you want to skip tutorial and press play!
[/b]

notes.title: BEAST IS NOW LIVE! TEST YOUR SKILLS IN BRUTAL TURN-BASED COMBAT!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings travelers![/h1]

[h3][b]Today is a special day when BEAST enters the realm of Early Access and is available to play now![/b][/h3]
[h3]We sincerely invite you to be one of the first to try our first production as a False Prophet Dev Team. Your feedback is now a crucial part of our strategy for further updates and patches so please feel free to post it here on the Steam forum or on our official Discord channel.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35672639/a789fdd4948a7384e6e214062721dd74f5e6b0a0.png[/img]

[h3][b]Below is some good info to help you have a good time with your exclusive code! Please read through it all.[/b][/h3]
[h3][list]
[*]We recommend playing with a mouse and keyboard for now. 
[*]You are playing exclusive pre-alpha content. 
[*]Early Access Steam opens October 25th 
[*]Full game Release in 2024. 
[*]You will experience the story from two sides with Anton and later, Prince Nicolai.
[/list][/h3]
[h3][b]WHAT IS THE CURRENT STATE & CONTENT OF THE EARLY ACCESS VERSION?
[/b][/h3]
[h3][*]The EA version is currently in the Pre-Alpha (early) state and contains a chunk of the game (and bugs)
with over 20 playable missions, 2 main characters, 7 enemy classes, 11 enemy types, and 40
weapon types. Many hours of replayable fun await! Localized versions of the game will arrive
later this year.[/h3]

[h3][b]TIPS, TRICKS & MORE TALKING POINTS[/b][/h3]
[list]
[h3][*]We recommend checking out all three tutorials to fully understand the uniqueness of the system.
[*]Remember to collect consumable crates. Ammunition is very valuable and a very limited resource in BEAST.
[*]If you score a critical hit you will see some bloody and gory dismemberment.
[*]There will be difficulty levels from easier to hardcore where if you die, it’s permanent and
you’ll have to restart the game.[/h3]
[/list]

[h3][b]In addition to the Early Access release, be prepared for an official DEVELOPER LIVE STREAM starting just after 5 PM CEST. During the stream, we will show you the basics of the game and we will go through the first stages of the game together! If you have any questions some small Q&A will be also available![/b][/h3]

[h3][b]See you all here on the Steam BEAST Store Page[/b][/h3]
[h2][b]False Prophet Team[/b][/h2]

notes.title: BEAST Early Access is opening on October 25th 2023!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35672639/395f6700cf09c11bfa0d3549bf6ce065bd13e10a.png[/img]

[h3][b]Early Access and Content Creator program announced![/b][/h3]
[b]We're very happy to announce that you will be able to play BEAST through Early Access from October 25th! If you're not only a curious player but also a content creator, we're happy to tell you that we will be opening our Content Creator Program from that same day as well but you can already get in touch by [url=https://creators.beastvideogame.com/]signing up here![/url][/b]

[previewyoutube=GlgvSLkHXNY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Why Early Access?[/b][/h3]
[list]
[b][*]We want to make sure we create the best possible game for fans of turn-based tactical RPGs.
Early Access allows us to be close to our current and future players who will be able to join our journey of completing our first game. Having our foundation solid and validated by our BEAST community before we launch the full game is our highest priority.

[/b][/list][h3][b]How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?[/b][/h3]
[list]
[b][*]We are very excited to go on this journey where there will be frequent updates to the game, community surveys and insights into our development and how your feedback is vital in all of it. We consider our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1145630/discussions/]Steam forums[/url] and official [url=sicord.gg/bastvideogame]Discord channel[/url] our prime channels to talk with us.

[/b][/list][h3][b]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/b][/h3]
[list]
[b][*]The EA version is currently in Alpha (early) state and contains a chunk of the game with over 20 playable missions, 2 main characters, 7 enemy classes, 11 enemy types and 40 weapon types. Many hours of replayable fun awaits! More languages are coming later this year as well.

[/b][/list][h3][b]Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?[/b][/h3]
[list]
[b][*]We’re committed to 2024 so it’s months rather than years.

[/b][/list][h3][b]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?[/b][/h3]
[list]
[b][*]As this is truly an Alpha version of the game (which means actual early code) there is a lot of stuff planned to be implemented, fixed, updated, balanced and optimized before full release. You will hear temporary music, voice overs and sound effects. You will see strange animations & graphics and you’ll likely be able to exploit combat systems at times. The full game will include side missions, additional story missions, more customization, enemies and much more. If you’re looking to be able to get in early and help finish a dark tactical game you’d want to play, this is it!

[/b][/list][h3][b]Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?[/b][/h3]
[list]
[b][*]Yes, the “Loyal Edition” which we will talk more about shortly will only be available during Early Access and will include the game, digital artbook, wallpapers, unique weapon, equipment skins and soundtrack (content will be able to be downloaded as they become available) for a special price as a thank you to our early adopters (subject to change).
[/b][/list]
